key.name: recent-files
key.description: The 20 most recently opened file URIs, newest first, for document completion.

key.name: window-maximized
key.summary: Whether the editor window is maximized

key.name: session-files
key.description: Ordered file URIs to reopen at startup. Untitled tabs are not included.

key.name: org-indent-mode
key.description: Visually indent sections by heading depth and hide extra heading stars without modifying file contents.

key.name: show-line-numbers
key.description: Display line numbers beside the text in all file editors.

key.name: zoom
key.description: Font size of the editor text, in percent of the default size.

key.name: agenda-directory
key.description: Folder whose .org files (including subfolders), together with open Org documents, are listed below the utility pane calendar. Each file has a stable color dot matching its calendar events. Click a file to edit it; use the checkmark on the right to include its entries in Calendar and Agenda. Calendar excludes scheduled entries and deadlines; Agenda includes them without a global TODO list. A leading ~ is expanded to the home folder.

key.name: hidden-agenda-files
key.summary: Files hidden from Calendar and Agenda
key.description: Canonical file URIs unchecked in the utility pane. Hidden files remain available in the editor, and visibility choices persist across sessions.

key.name: hide-weekends
key.description: Show only Monday through Friday in the weekly calendar without changing dated entries.
